user.title: Set up Robotix Home Intelligence - Mobility Module
user.description: Publishes Mobility build specifications, consumes Foundation-selected build input, exposes canonical Mobility Public Runtime V2, Energy V2 and safe Mobility-owned controls. No command runs automatically at startup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Robotix Home Intelligence - Mobility Module is already configured.

configure_product_asset.title: Choose vehicle or charger
configure_product_asset.description: Choose a logical vehicle or charger. The list is searchable; type its name, model or integration label.

edit_product_asset.title: Configure {asset}
edit_product_asset.description: Edit Mobility-owned product semantics. Actual/readback values remain source-owned and are never replaced by requested or configured values.

add_vehicle_profile.title: Add custom vehicle profile
add_vehicle_profile.description: Add one vehicle model that is not already in the verified catalog. Use exact product identity and real technical specifications.

data_description.display_name: Human-readable product name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.short_name: Compact label for cards and constrained views.
data_description.brand: Manufacturer brand, for example Audi, BMW or Volkswagen.
data_description.model: Product model, for example Q8 or i4.
data_description.variant: Exact derivative/trim needed to distinguish the product.
data_description.model_year: Model year used as part of the exact catalog identity.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable/authoritative battery capacity for this product profile.
data_description.phase_capability: Number of AC phases supported by the vehicle.

add_charger_profile.title: Add custom charger profile
add_charger_profile.description: Add one charger model that is not already in the verified catalog. Use exact product identity and electrical limits.

data_description.display_name: Human-readable product name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.short_name: Compact label for cards and constrained views.
data_description.model_year: Optional model year where it materially distinguishes the hardware.
data_description.min_current_a: Lowest current the charger can reliably request.
data_description.nominal_voltage_v: Nominal AC voltage used for the product profile.

edit_selected_profile.title: Edit {name}
edit_selected_profile.description: Edit the selected product directly. Save returns to the searchable profile catalog so you can continue with the next product.

remove_selected_profile.title: Remove {name}
remove_selected_profile.description: A profile can only be removed when no Mobility asset or guest vehicle uses it.

add_guest_vehicle.title: Add guest vehicle
add_guest_vehicle.description: Create a Mobility-owned vehicle without a technical Foundation device.

remove_guest.title: Remove {name}
remove_guest.description: Remove this guest vehicle and its Mobility-owned configuration.

manage_profiles.title: Profiles
manage_profiles.description: Search the catalog, edit one profile directly, or add a custom vehicle/charger profile. Saving an edit returns here so multiple profiles can be maintained in one session.

data_description.action: Choose what you want to do. Editing is the default for fast repeated maintenance.
data_description.profile: Type a brand, model, variant or year to find the profile. Packaged and local override profiles use the same stable product identity.
